thread:
Rana: Quick callout  vendors surfaced slightly diverging timelines for H100/H200, B200-lite, MI300 and Gaudi. Need a lightweight operational pattern so marketplace flips don't collide with partner press.
Cole: Agree. Main risk is mixed "Available" badges appearing while SI certs are still pending in APAC.
Tara: SI update: Gaudi APAC fw patch ETA +10 days, MI300 EU perf microfix ETA +3 days. H100/H200 nominal. B200-lite is OK but quant pipeline needs a sanity check.
Ben: Product: suggest a minimal two-flag approach: marketplace_ready (auto) + press_clear (manual). marketplace_ready only true after SI cert webhook + 48h canary.
Rana: Ops-runbook sketch:
```
1) Wait SI.cert(region)==true && pass_rate>=95%
2) Flip "coming-soon" -> "limited" and start 48h announce-canary (route ~1% traffic)
3) Monitor latency/error/model-regressions; if green -> set marketplace_ready
4) Comms/Partners do press_clear -> set press_clear=true -> public announce
```
Cole: Add circuit-breaker: if error_rate >1.5% or latency > SLO+15% for 10m during canary -> auto rollback to "limited" and notify vendors.
Tara: SI will emit webhook payloads to /integrations/si/certs with fields: sku, region, cert_ts, pass_rate, cert_id, blocking_notes. We'll also include suggested_stability_window when available.
Ben: UI: marketplace card should show region badges and a small "pending SI" tooltip. Avoid any wording implying global availability.
VendorBot: Action created: PART-9988 allocate canary pools (APAC 2x, EU 1x). Invite: infra-oncall.
PressOps: Press rules: partners must not publish embargoed quotes until press_clear. We'll centralize partner copy and require partner_ack signoff before press_clear flips.
Rana: Telemetry: runtime should tag requests during canary with announce_canary=true and record fallback events: X-Fallback:quant when we route to B200-lite-quant variant.
Cole: Runtime also add an alert if fallback rate > 2% in 5m window. That triggers paging to oncall and partner ops.
Tara: SI action: will post an interim cert status update tomorrow AM and flag any lanes failing perf >5% so we can decide to keep canary longer.
Ben: Marketing: prepare two embargo snippets: "region-limited" and "wave-release". Keep partner quotes generic and avoid APAC dates until Gaudi stabilizes.
Rana: Quick action list:
- Tara: publish cert webhooks + pass_rate + cert_id (tomorrow AM)
- Cole/Infra: confirm PART-9988 canary pool allocation (now)
- Ben/Marketing: embargo snippets + partner copy doc (EOD)
- Runtime: implement canary tagging + fallback metric (2 days)
- PressOps/VendorBot: hold partner_ack gating for press_clear (before announce)

VendorBot: Calendar: "HW announce gating - marketplace & press handshake" scheduled 2026-05-06 14:00 UTC.
Rana: If any partner starts external comms before press_clear, escalate to me and PressOps immediately. Otherwise we'll proceed with staggered region flips and consolidated press waves.
